args.subject: Refund Processed for Invoice Currency Issue
args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 175 CHF‑4C9H to correct the invoicing error where the original invoice was issued in USD instead of your contracted currency CHF‑4C9H. The invoice record has been updated accordingly, and future invoices will be issued in CHF‑4C9H.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
